postings.description:
Director of Software Engineering

Reports to: VP of Engineering

Department: Engineering

Please note we can hire you in the following locations; UK, Germany, France, Belgium, Austria, Netherlands, Spain, and Finland

If you are not based in one of these countries then we are unable to move forward with your application.

💼 About the role

PQShield is looking for a Director of Software Engineering to lead the development of next-generation software products and architectures tailored for Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC).

In this leadership role, you will oversee the design, development, and optimisation of software solutions that secure and accelerate PQC algorithms, providing scalable and efficient cryptographic IP for software libraries and secure communication protocols.

As part of the Engineering leadership team, you will work closely with cross-functional groups, including cryptographers, hardware engineers, product managers, and external partners, to bring innovative PQC software solutions to market.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software development, cryptography, and secure product development, with a focus on delivering secure, high-performance, and efficient products.

We have been established since 2018, so you would be directly working with the founders and inventors of this deep tech startup. The technology is already a couple of years in the making, its feasibility having been established, funding secured, and it has a clear path to market. This is a great opportunity for career progression and to get a head start in a rapidly expanding segment of the technology industry.

⚒️ What you’ll be doing

Leadership & Strategy:

- Define and execute the software engineering strategy, aligning with the company’s overall PQC product roadmap.

- Lead and mentor a team of software engineers, developers, and software security experts, fostering a culture of innovation and technical excellence.

- Champion and continuously refine Agile development processes (e.g., Scrum, Kanban) to improve team velocity, predictability, and product quality.

- Stay informed about trends in post-quantum cryptography and its software implementations to ensure competitive positioning and forward-thinking solutions.

Software Development & Architecture:

- Oversee the design and implementation of cryptographic software libraries, secure protocols, and secure IP blocks optimised for PQC algorithms.

- Drive the design and integration of software for use cases such as secure key management, secure communication protocols, and cryptographic agility.

- Ensure the software architecture supports scalable and high-performance designs suitable for embedded systems, mobile, cloud, and data centre applications.

Project Management & Process:

- Support the execution of software projects using Agile methodologies, overseeing sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to ensure predictable delivery.

- Coordinate cross-functional teams, including cryptographers, hardware engineers, and external vendors to ensure seamless integration of software and cryptography solutions.

- Implement and enhance rigorous testing and verification methodologies, including a robust CI/CD pipeline for automated testing, integration, and deployment.

Collaboration & Communication:

- Work closely with the hardware and cryptography teams to ensure hardware-software co-design, ensuring that software products fully leverage the latest PQC hardware accelerators.

- Engage with external stakeholders, including open-source communities and enterprise customers, to manage the integration and deployment of PQC software IP.

- Communicate technical concepts and development progress to executives, product management, and customers in a clear and actionable way.

Security & Compliance:

- Ensure all software products meet the latest security standards and regulations for post-quantum cryptography.

- Maintain and enforce robust secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) principles, including side-channel attack resistance, secure coding practices, and cryptographic algorithm agility.

🎯 Required Skills And Qualifications

Required:

- Education: Phd, Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field with a focus on cryptography or cybersecurity.

- Experience:

- 10+ years of software development experience, with 5+ years in a leadership role.

- Strong experience in software security, cryptographic software implementations (e.g., OpenSSL, BoringSSL), and knowledge of post-quantum cryptography.

- Experience in secure software development and validation, including knowledge of C, C++, Rust, or other relevant languages.

- Proven experience in bringing secure software products from concept to market.

- Technical Skills:

- Software Development & Agile Processes: Deep, hands-on experience with modern software development methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, Kanban), including backlog grooming, sprint planning, and performance metric tracking (e.g., velocity, burn-down charts).

- Advanced Cryptography: Understanding of cryptographic algorithms, protocols, and key management systems. Familiarity with PQC standards and protocols (e.g., NIST PQC).

- Security Architecture: Expertise in designing and implementing secure architectures for software and cloud environments.

- Embedded Systems: Knowledge of secure software for embedded systems and IoT security.

- Software Security: Experience with software-based security solutions and an understanding of secure coding practices and vulnerability analysis.

- Secure Implementation: Understanding of the secure implementation of cryptography and systems which use cryptography. Knowledge of Implementation attacks such as Side Channel and Fault injection and implementation countermeasures.

🏆Some of the perks of working with us:

- Unparalleled opportunities to learn and accelerated career development.

- A collaborative, team environment with people who truly love what they do.

- Competitive salary and share option scheme.

- Flexible and hybrid working, and a working from home budget.

- Private health insurance for yourself and your family.

- 25 days annual leave (plus bank holidays and two wellness weeks).

- 50% gym membership discount.

- The chance to work with a spirited, smart, and friendly team!

Interested? Apply today to be part of the future of secure hardware! 🚀

PQShield is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We’re passionate about talent and proud to foster an inclusive environment; all applicants will be considered regardless of their gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, and age.

Lead Software Engineer

Reports to: Director of Engineering

Department: Engineering

💼 About the role

PQShield is looking for a Lead Software Engineer to help lead a cryptographic software IP team. As a Lead Software Engineer, you will be responsible for overseeing the entire software development lifecycle, from design to testing, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality software solutions. This includes planning, organizing, and managing the software development, including setting timelines, allocating resources, and tracking progress. You will work across a variety of environments, solving complex problems and developing other engineers, while maintaining a strong focus on quality and best practices. You will support the hiring, training, and managing of a team of software engineers, fostering collaboration, and resolving conflicts.

Candidates should hold a degree in Electronic Engineering/Computer Science or equivalent experience, backed by at least 10 years in software design and/or verification. We are looking for a technical lead—or a senior engineer ready to step up into leadership—to guide our team. Knowledge of cryptographic engineering and side-channel attack resistance is a major bonus. You should be ready to contribute to cross-team strategy, lead architectural reviews, and drive planning for your team.

Founded in 2018, we are a well-funded deep tech startup with proven technology and a clear path to market. Joining us now offers a unique opportunity to work directly with our founders and inventors, fast-track your career progression, and shape a rapidly expanding segment of the semiconductor industry (Post-Quantum Cryptography and RISC-V). This is a great opportunity for career progression and to get a head start in a rapidly expanding segment of the semiconductor industry (Post-Quantum Cryptography and RISC-V).

postings.description:
Product Marketing Director
Location: UK, France, Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, Austria, Spain, Finland, USA. Some travel to our offices will be required from time-to-time

Reports to: Chief Commercial Officer

💼 About the role

PQShield is looking for a Product Marketing Director who can turn complex technology into stories that people understand, remember, and act on.

You will own how PQShield's products, technology, and vision are positioned, communicated, and brought to market worldwide. You'll sit at the intersection of product, engineering, sales, customers, and the broader security market — translating breakthrough cryptography and security technology into compelling narratives for executives, engineers, partners, and buyers.

This role is for a strategic product marketer and exceptional storyteller who can identify the market shift, understand the customer problem, and turn complex technology into differentiated positioning that creates urgency, preference and demand.

Since NIST published its first post-quantum cryptography (PQC) standards, which the PQShield team co-authored, organizations across semiconductors, automotive, defense, and enterprise face significant challenges in preparing for the post-quantum transition. This role will help define the market narrative around that transition, position PQShield's portfolio within it and give customers a clear reason to act.

⚒️ What you’ll be doing

- Own the story: Develop the narrative, positioning, messaging, and value propositions that explain what is changing in the market, why customers need to act, the problem PQShield solves, and why our approach is differentiated.

- Turn technical capability into customer value: Work with cryptographers, engineers and product leaders to understand sophisticated technology, identify what matters to the buyer and translate technical capabilities into clear business and security value without sacrificing technical credibility.

- Position the portfolio: Own positioning and messaging for our hardware IP and software portfolio, including PQPlatform, PQPerform, PQCryptoLib, and PQMicroLib. Build a clear messaging architecture that connects the portfolio while preserving the differentiated value of each offering.

- Understand the customer: Develop deep insight into customer problems, buying journeys, security requirements, regulatory pressures, barriers to adoption, buying dynamics, and the forces driving post-quantum adoption. Turn those insights into sharper products, messaging, and go-to-market strategies.

- Shape category and market narrative: Help define how PQShield talks about post-quantum security, cryptographic agility, and the transition to quantum-safe systems — and how we differentiate our approach in a rapidly evolving market.

- Lead product launches: Create and execute compelling go-to-market strategies for new products, certifications, partnerships, and major releases.

- Equip the sales team: Build compelling presentations, stories, solution briefs, case studies, battlecards, and other tools that help sales teams communicate value and win complex deals.

- Build buyer and segment-specific stories: Develop differentiated narratives for semiconductors, automotive, military and aerospace, industrial IoT, networking, and enterprise, adapting the value story for different buyers, use cases and business priorities.

- Own competitive storytelling: Understand the competitive landscape and turn technical and commercial differences into clear, credible differentiation.

- Create exceptional content: Lead the development of white papers, thought leadership, application notes, customer stories, executive content, web experiences, and other material that establishes PQShield as a category leader.

- Bring customer stories to life: Find and develop the stories that demonstrate why customers are making the transition to post-quantum security and why they choose PQShield.

- Work across the company: Partner closely with product, engineering, sales, partnerships, and leadership to ensure the market sees one clear, compelling PQShield story.

🎯 Required Skills And Qualifications

We're looking for an experienced product marketing leader who is exceptionally strong in positioning, messaging and strategic storytelling. You can take an emerging market, complicated buyer problem or deeply technical product and find the clear narrative inside it.

- 8+ years of marketing experience, with significant experience in product marketing, technology marketing, B2B marketing, or a closely related discipline.

- A proven ability to develop positioning and stories that change how markets understand a product, technology, or company.

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. You can take something highly technical and make it understandable, interesting, and compelling without dumbing it down.

- Strong storytelling instincts and the ability to find the human, business, and strategic narrative inside complex technology.

- Experience marketing technical B2B products, ideally in cybersecurity, semiconductors, infrastructure, embedded systems, software, or another sophisticated technology market.

- Strong understanding of security and technology buyers, and the ability to communicate credibly with CISOs, CTOs, engineers, architects, product leaders, and business executives.

- Demonstrated ability to work closely with technical experts and quickly develop enough subject-matter expertise to challenge assumptions, ask good questions, and tell an accurate story.

- A strong commercial mindset: you understand that great marketing isn't just about explaining a product — it's about creating differentiation, urgency, preference, and ultimately revenue.

- Experience launching products and taking complex offerings to market.

- Experience developing compelling sales narratives and enablement for complex, multi-stakeholder sales.

- Excellent strategic judgment, with the ability to determine what the market needs to hear, why it matters, and how PQShield should say it.

- Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where you will often need to create the narrative before the market has established one.

What we can offer you

- A competitive compensation package.

- Share options.

- A remote first company. You will work from home most of the time, but will need to join us in the office for planning sessions and key meetings as required.

- Travel for customer meetings and marketing events as needed.

- Health insurance.

- Generous PTO and holiday package.

- Company contributions towards 401K/pension

- …and other great benefits.

If you enjoy working as part of a technology company, value the security of our daily digital lives, and love solving hard problems - then we’d love to hear from you.

Revenue Operations Manager

Reports to: Chief Commercial Officer

Location: US/UK

💼 About the role

Here at PQShield we are at the forefront of Post-Quantum Cryptography that is changing how the world operates. We’ve helped shape all of the international PQC NIST standards, and we were the first cybersecurity company to develop quantum-safe cryptography on chips, in applications, and in the cloud.

PQShield is seeking an analytical Revenue Operations Manager to own our GTM systems, data, and processes across Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, and Account Management.

Beyond CRM administration, you will manage the end-to-end revenue engine including prospecting, lead qualification, pipeline progression, forecasting, and GTM tools and automation.

The ideal candidate brings deep HubSpot expertise, a strong understanding of B2B GTM stacks, and hands-on experience leveraging AI for prospect research and revenue workflow automation.

You will partner across cross-functional leadership to build a scalable, data-driven revenue operation.

⚒️ What you’ll be doing

Revenue Systems & GTM Tech Stack

- Administer and optimize HubSpot as the central system for all revenue activities.

- Manage the GTM tech stack, including enrichment tools, automation platforms, integrations, vendor relationships, and budgets.

- Maintain CRM structures for accounts, contacts, deals, pipelines, and lead stages.

- Ensure data quality, deduplication, and accuracy across systems.

- Integrate web forms, landing pages, and campaigns with HubSpot and third-party tools.

- Evolve the tech stack as the company scales.

AI-Powered Lead & Account Intelligence

- Develop processes for identifying and enriching target accounts and contacts using platforms such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Apollo, Clearbit, 6sense, Clay, or similar.

- Use AI to research companies, identify buying personas, discover relevant contacts, and enrich account records.

- Build automated workflows that combine CRM data with external data sources and AI-generated intelligence.

- Monitor target accounts for buying signals such as new executives, funding events, acquisitions, product announcements, and hiring activity.

- Use AI to summarize account intelligence and surface actionable insights for sales and marketing.

- Continuously evaluate new AI tools that can improve prospecting productivity and data quality.

Full-Funnel Process Design

- Own the full revenue lifecycle, from lead qualification to opportunity close and expansion.

- Define cross-functional lifecycle stages, handoffs, and SLAs for Marketing, Sales, and Partnerships.

- Establish sales stages and exit criteria with sales leadership.

- Create repeatable workflows across all lead sources and account tiers.

- Support account segmentation, territory design, and contact mapping.

- Track multi-stakeholder engagement across target enterprise accounts.

- Track contracts, renewals, and expansion to maintain post-sale visibility in the CRM.

- Eliminate operational bottlenecks and automate repetitive workflows.

- Maintain documentation and training for revenue processes and tooling.

Forecasting, Planning & Analytics

- Lead the forecasting cadence, pipeline reviews, and forecast roll-ups for leadership.

- Drive annual/quarterly planning for quotas, targets, capacity models, and territories.

- Partner with Finance on bookings, revenue reporting, and commissions.

- Build executive dashboards to track key metrics:

- Pipeline creation, coverage, and velocity

- Full-funnel conversion from lead to closed revenue

- Marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline

- Source and campaign attribution

- Account and contact engagement

- Sales and partner activity

- Forecast accuracy and revenue performance

- Renewals and expansion

- Define consistent revenue metrics across Sales, Marketing, and Finance.

- Identify key revenue trends, risks, and performance anomalies.

Marketing Operations & Website

- - Own the connection between the corporate website and HubSpot, ensuring forms, landing pages, CTAs, tracking, and conversion events are captured correctly.

- Build the attribution model that shows which content, campaigns, channels, and website activity generate qualified pipeline and revenue.

🎯 Required Skills And Qualifications

- 4–8+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, or a closely related role, ideally with exposure to both sales and marketing sides of the funnel.

- Deep hands-on experience administering and optimizing HubSpot, including CRM, Marketing Hub, and Sales Hub.

- Experience owning forecasting, pipeline management, and executive reporting.

- Demonstrated experience with B2B lead generation, contact enrichment, and account intelligence.

- Experience with LinkedIn, ZoomInfo, Apollo, or similar data platforms.

- Practical experience using AI tools to automate revenue operations, prospect research, enrichment, or data workflows.

- Highly analytical with rigorous attention to data quality.

- Comfortable in a startup environment where you will build processes rather than inherit them.

- Strong communication skills and the credibility to work directly with sales, marketing, finance, and executive leadership.

👍 Preferred Skills And Qualifications

- Experience with Clay, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, 6sense, Clearbit, or similar AI/data platforms.

- Experience building AI-powered enrichment or prospecting workflows.

- Experience with account-based marketing and strategic-account mapping.

- Experience supporting a global GTM organization across multiple regions.

🏆Some of the perks of working with us:

Here at PQShield we are at the forefront of Post-Quantum Cryptography that is changing how the world operates. We’ve helped shape all of the international PQC NIST standards, and we were the first cybersecurity company to develop quantum-safe cryptography on chips, in applications, and in the cloud.
